items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: the guitar player was unable to play, Al Nevins, and I jumped in and subbed for him.

ctx.x: Didn’t someone record that with words later on?

The Platters, yeah. But they came on it and I had known them because they were guests on the Vaughn Monroe Show. And unfortunately the guitar player was unable to play, Al Nevins, and I jumped in and subbed for him. I put on his gray tuxedo and played on his D’Angelico guitar which I still have. And in the evening they asked me to play at the Astor Hotel — everything was a block away. I lived two blocks away at The Woodby on 45th Street. Kate Smith was on 44th Street and the Astor was between us.
You just walked to all these gigs.
